# Ana Silva · Remote sensing and GIS

> Freelance remote sensing and GIS from Sofia, Bulgaria, for ecology, environmental assessment and nature-risk teams: habitat pre-mapping and monitoring, site screening for lenders and nature disclosures, and AI-assisted GIS workflows. Built on open data. Freelance work is contracted through Timebooster. Agriculture work is taken on through Atlastico. Languages: Portuguese, English, Bulgarian, Spanish (comprehension).

Every study states its method, how it was checked against imagery or independent data, and its limits.

## Services

- Habitat pre-mapping and monitoring: Desk-based habitat maps from Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2 and LiDAR before the field survey, with a parcel table for the ecologist, and repeat imagery between monitoring visits.
- Site screening for sensitive locations: Sites screened on open data against protected areas, critical habitat, water risk and land cover, shaped for IFC PS6, EBRD PR6 and the TNFD Locate phase.
- AI-assisted GIS workflows: Guidance and training for GIS teams on using AI assistants safely: what to hand over, what to check, and how to keep client data at home.

Desk work delivered as GIS layers, tables and methods notes that drop into the client's own report; scope, price and turnaround agreed up front for each project.

## Freelance work

- [Agentic AI for GIS teams: faster production without leaking client data](https://kirjawa.github.io/ai-gis-guide.html): Three playbooks done with an AI agent on open data (schema-only setup, CAD to GIS, QGIS Atlas), ten failures from geospatial pipelines, the checks that catch them, and training formats for GIS teams.
- [Desk-based habitat pre-map and monitoring for biodiversity net gain](https://kirjawa.github.io/habitat-premap.html): A pre-map of the Fenwick Solar Farm site from open Sentinel-2, Sentinel-1 and LiDAR data, checked against its published biodiversity net gain survey, with the site's record since 2017, ten winters of flooding and a table for the statutory metric.
- [Monitoring a solar park between survey visits](https://kirjawa.github.io/solar-monitoring.html): Cleve Hill Solar Park in Kent from open Sentinel-2 and Sentinel-1 data: construction dated against the published milestones, and its habitat management area for wintering birds followed year by year, with what to check on the next ecologist visit.
- [Screening a portfolio for nature disclosures: Bulgaria](https://kirjawa.github.io/nature-disclosure-bulgaria.html): 504 solar parks and wind farms in Bulgaria screened on open data for the TNFD Locate phase, ESRS E4 and GRI 101-5: sites in or near sensitive locations, with the distance stated, and the land around them year by year.
- [Screening a portfolio for nature disclosures: Portugal](https://kirjawa.github.io/nature-disclosure-portugal.html): 733 solar parks and wind farms in mainland Portugal screened on open data for the TNFD Locate phase, ESRS E4 and GRI 101-5: sites in or near sensitive locations, with the distance stated, and the land around them year by year.
- [Where should five kindergartens advertise?](https://kirjawa.github.io/kindergarten-reach.html): Five Svetlina kindergartens in Sofia on an interactive map: the junctions, stops and everyday places where a poster or a leaflet reaches the families who could realistically enrol, by car, by public transport and on foot, from OpenStreetMap, the city's timetable and the census grid.
- [Maritsa Iztok: do the emissions seen from space match the reports?](https://kirjawa.github.io/maritsa-emissions.html): Sentinel-5P SO2 and NOx over Bulgaria's largest lignite complex, 2019 to 2024, against the EU emissions register.

## Agriculture, with Atlastico

- [Agriculture, with Atlastico](https://kirjawa.github.io/agriculture.html): Crop, field and supply-chain studies, taken on through Atlastico.
- [Palm oil mills: where does the fruit come from?](https://kirjawa.github.io/palm-oil.html): Road-based sourcing areas and forest clearing since the EUDR cutoff for 361 palm oil mills in West Kalimantan and Riau.
- [Dobrudja: how long does the soil lie bare?](https://kirjawa.github.io/soil-cover.html): Field-by-field soil cover in Bulgaria's grain belt, 2019 to 2025, and whether the 2023 soil-cover rule changed it.
- [Southern Niger: are farmers' fields getting woodier?](https://kirjawa.github.io/farmland-trees.html): Forty years of dry-season Landsat over farmland in Maradi and Zinder, separating rain from farmer-managed regrowth.
- [Season's Pulse: every field's season, dekad by dekad](https://kirjawa.github.io/season-pulse/): An interactive replay of 7,567 fields on Bulgaria's Danube plain, 2025 to 2026: the crop, its growth against the region and its own past, and field events.

## Maps

- [November, in maps](https://kirjawa.github.io/maps.html): One map a day for the #30DayMapChallenge, November 2026: Copernicus Sentinels and other open data, animations, and paintings borrowed for their palettes, each with its sources.
